title: GlobalX策略师：AI基建需求强劲，中国科技估值仍低？
speaker: Billy Lung

segments.en: You're correct to say that that's a good observation I mean even we just look at the U.S. stocks index or the philly philly philly semi index in terms of turnover it's nearly doubled in the past 12 months and I think that is a function of like you said we've seen more leverage products whether it be 2x 3x single stock and I think that has driven a lot of the strength.
segments.zh: 你的观察很对。即使看美国指数或费城半导体指数，过去12个月成交量几乎翻倍。我认为这是杠杆产品（如2倍、3倍单股ETF）推动的。

segments.en: But I think it's also important to know that yes there is a lot of liquidity driven strength in terms of where the index levels are but at the same time we are looking at a potential market which is growing at over 100% and potentially 30% or even 40% next year but still trading a single digits.
segments.zh: 但重要的是，指数水平确实有流动性驱动的强势，同时我们看到的潜在市场增长超过100%，明年可能30%-40%，但估值仍在个位数。

segments.en: So I think in terms of you know like you mentioned it is very much market dynamics or market technicals right now but in terms of the long term structural growth valuation we don't see this as a very big issue right now.
segments.zh: 所以，目前更多是市场动态或技术面因素，但从长期结构性增长和估值看，我们并不认为这是大问题。
